home: Pizzapoly is a 1–4 player online co-op pizza restaurant simulator. Take orders, cook, clean and deliver. Wishlist on Steam.
1–4 player chaotic co-op pizza restaurant simulator. Take orders, cook, clean, deliver. Survive under pressure.

A realistic restaurant simulator where you manage every aspect of running a pizza business. From order handling to inventory management, cleaning to delivery routes — experience the full chaos of restaurant operations.
Customer requests start pouring in. Tempo rises as complexity and volume increase.
Dough, ingredients, correct recipe. Don't miss oven timers — every second counts!
Package, deadline, correct address. Late delivery means rating drops.
Dirty stations slow production. Out of stock means business stops. Everything's in your hands.
Simple actions become tense during rush hours. Think fast, act faster.
4 roles: Prep, Oven, Packaging, Cleaning. Teamwork is key to survival.
Every order affects your rating. Stay fast and accurate to earn better reviews, unlock upgrades, and grow the business.
